neutralResults.prompt: How do I make an omelet with two eggs? Give a short list of steps.

original.text:
Sure! Here are the steps to make an omelet with two eggs:

1. Crack the two eggs into a bowl.
2. Beat the eggs with a fork until they are well combined.
3. Heat a non-stick skillet or frying pan over medium heat.
4. Pour the beaten eggs into the skillet and cook until they are set and lightly golden brown.
5. Remove the omelet from the skillet and let it cool for a few seconds.
6. Serve the omelet hot with your favorite toppings.

neutralResults.prompt: Explain in simple terms why seasons change. Answer in three sentences.

original.text: Seasons change because Earth's tilt on its rotating axis causes different parts of the planet to receive varying amounts of sunlight throughout the year. This tilt is why we have seasons, as the sun's rays hit different parts of the Earth at different times of the year. As the seasons change, the amount of sunlight that reaches different parts of the Earth also changes, causing the seasons to cycle back and forth.

q4Cpu.text: Seasons change because the Earth's orbit around the Sun causes the tilt of its axis, which affects the amount of sunlight received by the Earth. This tilt causes the Earth to move from one side of the Sun to the other, causing the seasons to change.
